rule_candidates.description: Exact reproducer plus bounded corrective test supports source-level closure more reliably than adding new names or sessions
rule_candidates.counterexample: A previously failing local test is repaired but a comparable later real-device test still fails
rule_candidates.prospective_test: Randomize two equally small in-scope backlog repairs to exact-repro-first versus architecture-first; compare verified fixed cases, hours and regression escapes

rule_candidates.description: When a real outside receiver or current independent host is missing, publication/CI successes do not close product usefulness
rule_candidates.counterexample: Independent receiver reports useful task completion and durable recovery without the hypothesized required bridge
rule_candidates.prospective_test: Run one consented first-use acceptance with GitHub fallback and one independently administered restore; compare result before and after receiver binding

rule_candidates.description: Privacy and evidence gates should be selectively retained; blocking anchors need owners, release conditions, and bounded escape paths
rule_candidates.counterexample: Removing the review gate causes no reduction in safety/quality over multiple comparable independent trials
rule_candidates.prospective_test: Ablate only one low-risk redundant documentation approval under a rollback cap; retain privacy/security gate; measure completion and proof debt

next_elected_action.parallel_independent_safe_lane: Consenting first-use offline CoPreCursor through GitHub START_HERE, with no bulk outreach
next_elected_action.gate: owner-reviewed legacy site privacy plus independent canonical HTTP readproof
next_elected_action.success_metric: One corrected safe human landing with two-vantage host proof, followed by a non-builder useful task receipt; no stars/clicks proxy

method.do_not_claim: Correlational selection does not prove anchor causation
method.drift_envelope: Permit bounded change while preserving privacy, safety, evidence and user exit
method.human_time: Measure minutes from issue visibility to useful receiver outcome, and manual relay count
